items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: He says, 'did you ever hear of Ray Wetzel?' I said, 'sure, the great trumpet player.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Because the next day we were getting in the car and driving out to Nebraska on the way to meet the band, in Fall City, Nebraska I think it was. So anyway to make a long © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

story short, my wife got pregnant early and had to leave me on the road, she had to go home. So my father and mother found a place in North Bergen, they were building new apartments in those days and so we got an apartment over there. And when she had the baby I wanted to get time off because of the baby. And Woody wouldn’t give it to me. So I said well I’m going to have to leave the band. He says okay. So I left the band. And the last night I had with the band we were playing at Buckeye Lake, Ohio, it’s a big…
